jobs.occupation: Cream Consulting by Audensiel - Business Analyst Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

 

The cream recipe:

- 1/3 Personal development - 1/3 Collective intelligence - 1/3 Intrapreneurship - Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues
Your future projects 

Like Teddy, Business Analyst Business Intelligence at Cream, translate the BI needs of the business teams in specifications for the IT department, for both small demands or as part of larger projects (contributions or BI project). Your tasks will be

• Act as person of contact between Business Engineering Teams and the Development Team

• Define the business specifications for BI needs

• Participation in (or management of) BI projects, or on the BI tracks of other projects for the engineering activities (requirement definition, impact analysis, process definition), while representing the BI vision (and BI target architecture) that has been defined

• Collaboration with data delivery experts to deliver on projects

• Understand business requirements and build a functional analysis which covers needs of the business according to our BI reference architecture

• Collaborate with the development team

What do we expect from our Consultant ?

• You have a Master degree in Computer Sciences or equivalent by experience

• You have at least 2 years of experience in data and business analysis

• You have good knowledge in BI techniques and tools (BO, SAS, Cognos...)

• You have a cultural openness and adaptability, you are rigorous, customer oriented, and you have high communication skills and analytical skills

• You are polyvalent and can adapt easily to quickly changing environment

• You are capable to think out of the box and maintain in the meantime a pragmatic approach

• You are able to work with autonomy while being also a great team player

• You are fluent in French and English; a good knowledge of Dutch is an asset

• You are committed to travelling abroad occasionally upon the client's request

-

jobs.occupation: Store Assistant / Sales Associate – Christmas Shop | Bruges | Full-Time
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working in a welcoming retail environment and love the magic of Christmas? Do you enjoy helping customers find the perfect decorations for the holiday season?

For a unique Christmas store in the heart of Bruges, we are looking for an enthusiastic Store Assistant / Sales Associate who will help customers bring the Christmas spirit into their homes.

What will you do?
As a Sales Associate, you will be the face of the store and ensure that every customer enjoys a warm and pleasant shopping experience.

Your responsibilities include:

• Welcoming and assisting customers in a friendly manner
• Advising customers on Christmas decorations, ornaments, gifts and seasonal products
• Maintaining an attractive and organized store presentation
• Restocking shelves and keeping the store clean and tidy
• Processing payments and handling cash register duties
• Assisting with deliveries and unpacking new merchandise

• You enjoy working with customers and providing excellent service
• You are willing to work weekends on a rotating schedule
• Previous retail or sales experience is an advantage
• You speak Spanish, Dutch or English fluently
• In addition to your strongest language, you can communicate at a basic level in at least one of the other languages
• You enjoy working in an international environment with tourists and visitors from different countries
• You are enthusiastic, reliable and enjoy working as part of a team

Project description

In this role, you lead complex multidisciplinary industrial engineering projects within the process industry. You are fully accountable for scope, budget, planning, quality and safety across both new installations and major modifications to existing assets.

Primary Tasks & Responsibilities

• Take end-to-end ownership of industrial engineering projects from concept and feasibility through commissioning and final handover.
• Define and manage project scope, deliverables, budget (including business case and investment approval) and baseline planning in MS Project.
• Coordinate all project phases: pre-study and concept selection, basic and detailed engineering, procurement and contractor selection, construction and site execution, commissioning, and handover to operations.
• Act as the single point of accountability for internal stakeholders and management.
• Lead multidisciplinary teams across mechanical, electrical, automation, piping, civil and EHS disciplines, working with both internal and external parties.
• Manage scope changes, risks, claims, and deviations affecting budget or schedule.
• Report progress, issues and decisions to steering committees and senior stakeholders.

Technical profile requirements

• Minimum 10 years of experience as a Project Manager with proven A-Z ownership of industrial CAPEX projects.
• Minimum 7 years of experience as a Project Engineer in disciplines such as mechanical, electrical, piping or civil engineering.
• Demonstrated experience with pre-feasibility and concept studies, CAPEX budgeting and investment approval, and commissioning of industrial installations.
• Mandatory experience in the process industry.
• Strong hands-on command of MS Project, with ownership of planning rather than follow-up only.
• Academic working level combined with strong analytical skills and a helicopter view.
Non-Technical profile requirements

• You work autonomously and take full ownership of your responsibilities.
• You bring strong leadership skills and can challenge stakeholders and contractors when needed.
• You communicate effectively with stakeholders at every organisational level.
• You bring natural authority in complex industrial environments.
Methodology / Certification requirements

• VCA-Vol is mandatory.
• PMP / Prince2 is a plus.
Language proficiencies

• Dutch: Native / Fluent
• English: Fluent

jobs.occupation: Sales Advisor Toyota City / Lexus Zaventem
jobs.description:
About us

Inchcape is the leading global automotive distributor operating in +40 markets. We partner with some of the biggest brands in the business to sustainably power better mobility today and in the future.

Our diverse global team of over 16,000 talented colleagues foster an inclusive and collaborative culture, delivering a brilliant experience for our customers and partners. We're a dynamic and fast-growing business, driving the transformation of our industry and redefining tomorrow.

Inchcape Belux employs over 250 team members. Our portfolio includes vehicle distribution for world-renowned brands, market leading fulfilment solutions, exceptional retail experiences, and tailored financial services.

 

Do you want to develop world-class skills, build a brilliant career, and thrive within a highly supportive team? Join Inchcape Belux, part of Inchcape's global network.

You'll play a key role in delivering outstanding customer experiences while representing one of the world's most trusted automotive brands. You'll be part of a dynamic team where collaboration, performance, and customer satisfaction are central.

Our Toyota City Zaventem team is looking for a Sales Advisor New Cars to support the sales of new Toyota and Lexus vehicles. In this role, you will guide customers throughout their buying journey, actively manage leads, and ensure a seamless and professional sales experience.

What you'll do
 
• Drive showroom sales for both B2B and B2C customers. 
• Actively prospect and develop new fleet clients while ensuring close follow‑up of all B2B and B2C leads. 
• Handle daily leads in line with brand standards and deliver strong performance on mystery leads, emails, calls, visits, and test drives. 
• Deliver excellent customer experience by informing, advising, and following up professionally, building long‑term trust and satisfaction. 
• Act as a Toyota Brand Ambassador in the showroom, during events, and on social media, with a polished appearance and courteous behaviour. 
• Apply Toyota's Omotenashi principles to create a warm, personalised customer experience. 
• Ensure flawless test drives and a smooth, high‑quality delivery process for customers. 
• Upsell additional products and services such as financing, insurance, and accessories. 
• Complete all administrative tasks accurately and in line with internal procedures. 
• Contribute to high customer recommendation and online reputation scores by consistently delivering top‑tier service. 
 

 

About you

To be successful in this role you will be:
 
• Passionate about the automotive industry and eager to build a career in sales. 
• Results‑driven and proactive, motivated to seize every sales opportunity. 
• Experienced in a customer‑facing role where customer satisfaction was the top priority. 
• Able to work independently and collaboratively in a fast‑paced environment. 
• Fluent in Dutch and French, with a good knowledge of English.

Team/division description:

You will be working for the Human Resources division, called People & Innovation. You will be part of the Data Analytics and HR Solutions team (part of Business Innovation within P&I). Our main purpose is to ensure HR data is accurate, governed, business-relevant, and transformed into trusted analytics and reporting solutions by acting as the primary bridge between HR business stakeholders, IT data teams, and reporting developers.

At P&I we strive to deliver effective solutions towards business leaders and our Pan-E regional HR counterparts. Listening to the customer is essential to developing adequate and efficient solutions.

Your responsibilities

Your role is to support building foundation and contribute to strong employee experiences.

 
• 
HR Data Governance & Data Quality

 
• 
Business Analysis within HR Data Domain

 
• 
Bridge between HR and ITD Data Product Delivery Team

 
• 
Overview Snowflake operations (catalogue, ingest, semantic modelling design)

 
• 
Managing Power BI Reporting Portfolio (prioritisation and budget control)

 
• 
Stakeholder Management (withing HR areas and business)

 
• 
Monitoring testing and release management

 
• 
Ensure compliance, privacy & security rules are followed

Your profile:

 
• 
English (Professional/Business Fluency), other languages are also an asset.

 
• 
Experience with Snowflake, Collibra and Data Product creation is essential for this role

 
• 
Knowledge of SQL, Qlick, Power BI is an asset

 
• 
Stakeholder Management

 
• 
Able to work with HR executives, HR operations teams, Data engineers, Solution architects, BI developers, Vendors

 
• 
Strong ability to simplify complex concepts, create executive summaries, present risks and recommendations.

 
• 
Our ideal candidate can facilitate workshops, and liaise with multinational teams

 
• 
The ideal candidate has a natural interest in the customer voice. They have proven similar past experiences, in the field of data governance, analytics, AI solutions design.

 
• 
Must be able to challenge assumptions, connect data across systems, identify root causes, spot inconsistencies.
